source_text: Vae vobis Scribae et Pharisaei hypocritae, quia similes estis sepulcris dealbatis, quae a foris parent speciosa, intus plena ossibus mortuorum. Sic et vos a foris paretis justi, intus pleni hypocrisi et iniquitate. Omnis justitia simulata mortua justitia est.
pass_a_gloss: Woe to you Scribes and Pharisees hypocrites, because similar you-are to tombs whitewashed, which from-outside appear beautiful, within full of bones of-dead. So also you from-outside appear just, within full of hypocrisy and iniquity. Every justice simulated dead justice is.
pass_b_english: [[Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for you are like whitewashed tombs >> Bible:Matthew 23:27]] — fair outside, full of dead bones within. So you appear righteous to people, yet inside are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness. Every pretended justice is a dead justice.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
